title.en: Boss Fight: The Night Before Launch

tagline.zh: 三个 bug，一个倒计时，没有提示
tagline.en: Three bugs, one countdown, no hints

story.zh: 零点秒杀开抢。现在是 23:55，测试红了一片：库存会超卖，优惠券算错钱，倒计时显示离谱。三个 bug 藏在三个文件里。
story.en: The flash sale opens at midnight. It's 23:55 and the tests are red: inventory oversells, coupons miscalculate, the countdown is nonsense. Three bugs in three files.

goal.zh: 5 分钟内让测试全绿。除了开场那一句，这一关没有提示词按钮，怎么指挥 Qoder 你自己定。
goal.en: Get every test green within 5 minutes. Past the opening line there are no prompt buttons on this level: how you direct Qoder is up to you.

openingPrompt.zh: 紧急情况：5 分钟后上线。先跑 node --test 看看有多惨
openingPrompt.en: Emergency: we launch in 5 minutes. Run node --test first and show me how bad it is

hint.zh: 自己打字指挥。想省时间就一句话讲清楚：修什么、不许动什么、修完怎么验证。
hint.en: Type your own orders. To save time, say it all in one go: what to fix, what not to touch, how to verify.

hint.zh: Qoder 在 Auto 模式下自己跑命令、自己改文件，你只管盯着测试变绿。
hint.en: In Auto mode Qoder runs commands and edits files on its own. Your job is to watch the tests go green.

label.zh: 测试文件没被动过手脚
